regime_context: Policy regime is a sequenced, interest-aligned campaign: Treasury/Bessent structurally suppresses front-end yields while Fed/Warsh banks hawkish credibility, holding easing as inflation-gated optionality post-midterm. The consensus narrative of a near-term pivot diverges from revealed preference — Warsh has held the inflation-mandate line through a hot PCE and a labor crack, so the tradable read is higher-for-longer with a two-sided stagflationary skew rather than imminent dovishness.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制是一场有序推进、利益对齐的行动：财政部/贝森特在结构上压低前端收益率，而美联储/沃什积累鹰派信誉，将宽松作为受通胀门控的中期选举后选项。关于近期转向的共识叙事与显现的偏好相背离——沃什在核心PCE偏热、就业数据走弱的情况下仍坚守通胀使命优先，因此可交易的解读是更长时间维持高利率且带有双向滞胀偏斜，而非即将转鸽。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse (7/8) has already re-primed the energy inflow rotation that was the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1 2026; Brent's ~$80 intraday spike and upside-skewed headline fragility favor energy vs SPY on a conflict-re-escalation path that the administration has not de-escalated.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂（7/8）已重新点燃能源板块资金轮动，该板块曾是2026年第一季度ETF资金流入最高的行业；布伦特原油盘中升至约80美元且头条驱动的上行偏斜，在冲突重新升级的路径上有利于能源跑赢SPY，而政府尚未降级该路径。
evidence: Iran / Middle East theater — ceasefire COLLAPSED (as of 7/8); oil two-sided but upside-skewed on headlines
Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026
FACT: Brent spiked ~$80 intraday 7/8; US strikes on Iran 7/8–11
theses.dissent: A de-escalation or ceasefire reinstatement would unwind the oil-risk premium quickly, and the same stagflationary conditions could depress energy demand expectations, capping XLE upside.
theses.dissent_zh: 若局势降级或重新达成停火，油价风险溢价将迅速消退，且同样的滞胀环境可能压低能源需求预期，限制XLE的上行空间。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% over the next 30 trading days without a fresh Iran escalation headline
falsifier.text_zh: 未来30个交易日内，在没有新的伊朗局势升级头条的情况下，XLE落后SPY 5%

theses.subject: SHLD
theses.thesis: NATO defense spending super-cycle is structural and independent of the Iran ceasefire state; the defense-bid persists regardless, and the administration's strategic re-industrialization reinforces missile-defense/Golden Dome and shipbuilding capacity, favoring defense primes vs broad equity.
theses.thesis_zh: 北约国防开支超级周期是结构性的，独立于伊朗停火状态；无论局势如何，国防买盘持续存在，而政府的战略再工业化强化了导弹防御/金穹和造船能力，有利于国防龙头跑赢大盘。
evidence: NATO / Defense theater — a structural spending super-cycle (FACT budget/NATO)
Defense bid persists regardless (Iran theater read)
Targeted/high-confidence rotation: PPA, SHLD among proxies
theses.dissent: Past SHLD/defense overweight calls have missed (ITA realized -0.104, -0.108), suggesting either mean-reversion or the rotation is already priced in short-term.
theses.dissent_zh: 此前SHLD/国防的超配判断已经失手（ITA实际回报-0.104、-0.108），表明短期内要么存在均值回归，要么该轮动已被定价。

falsifier.text: SHLD lags SPY by 6% over the next 60 trading days despite no NATO spending cut signal
falsifier.text_zh: 未来60个交易日内，在没有北约削减开支信号的情况下，SHLD落后SPY 6%

check.note: graded via correlated surrogate XLI (no local series for SHLD)

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh's revealed preference is inflation-mandate first with CME FedWatch pricing >70% probability of a September hike; the real 10y has already risen through the credibility-banking phase, and with no cut priced ahead of the median path, long-duration Treasuries face continued repricing risk vs SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 沃什显现的偏好是通胀使命优先，CME FedWatch对9月加息的定价概率超过70%；实际10年期收益率在信誉积累阶段已经上行，且在中位路径之前没有降息被定价，长端美债相对SPY面临持续的重新定价风险。
evidence: CME FedWatch moved to >70% probability of a Sept hike
Warsh held hawkish line at Sintra; declined to signal July
Open prediction: Fed does NOT cut at July and September 2026
theses.dissent: The labor crack (+57k June payrolls, downward revisions) is exactly the data that can reopen an easing path; a data-driven September pivot would rally TLT sharply.
theses.dissent_zh: 就业数据走弱（6月非农+57k，前期下修）恰恰是能重新打开宽松路径的数据；若9月出现数据驱动的转向，TLT将大幅反弹。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% over the next 45 trading days without a Fed cut being priced
falsifier.text_zh: 未来45个交易日内，在没有美联储降息被定价的情况下，TLT跑赢SPY 5%

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The advanced-chip tariff regime transition (Section 122 expiring, Section 301 replacement pending) preserves the onshoring premium contingent on a clean handoff; the de-risking mandate funds domestic chip capacity regardless of China truce tone, supporting semiconductor fabs vs broad equity.
theses.thesis_zh: 先进芯片关税体制过渡（第122条即将到期，第301条替代方案待定）在顺利交接的前提下保留在岸化溢价；无论中美缓和基调如何，去风险化使命都持续资助国内芯片产能，有利于半导体制造相对大盘跑赢。
evidence: China theater — onshoring bid persists contingent on Section 301 handoff completing cleanly
SCOTUS strike-down did NOT unwind the tariff-protection premium
theses.dissent: A botched Section 301 handoff or tariff truce extension could remove the protection premium; broader tech multiple compression in a hike-majority regime would drag SMH regardless of onshoring policy.
theses.dissent_zh: 第301条交接不畅或关税休战延期可能消除保护溢价；在加息占多数的体制下，更广泛的科技股估值压缩将拖累SMH，无论在岸化政策如何。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 6% over the next 60 trading days while the advanced-chip tariff stays in force
falsifier.text_zh: 未来60个交易日内，在先进芯片关税维持有效的情况下，SMH落后SPY 6%

theses.subject: XLF
theses.thesis: The dealer-bank funding alignment thesis (Treasury buybacks, dealer-intermediation reform, eSLR progress) is still in the open-prediction stage without confirmed rule-making; with a hike-majority market and a 55%+ miss rate on past financials overweights, there is no revealed-interest edge to hold XLF vs SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 交易商银行资金对齐论点（财政部回购、交易商中介改革、eSLR进展）仍处于开放预测阶段，尚未有确认的规则制定；在加息占多数的市场环境下，且过去对金融股的超配失手率超过55%，持有XLF相对SPY没有显现的利益优势。
evidence: Open predictions: eSLR-reform progress, SEC central-clearing expansion remain unfilled
Past XLF overweight missed (realized -0.0541); KBE overweight missed (-0.0818)
Fed path gap: market ≈ Fed at end-2026, no easing tailwind for financials
theses.dissent: A surprise eSLR or central-clearing rule advancement would re-rate dealer banks sharply, and steepening front-end positioning could benefit net-interest-margin expectations despite hikes.
theses.dissent_zh: 若eSLR或中央清算规则出现意外推进，交易商银行将大幅重估，且前端曲线趋陡可能有利于净息差预期，尽管存在加息。

falsifier.text: XLF outperforms SPY by 5% over the next 45 trading days without a confirmed eSLR or central-clearing rule
falsifier.text_zh: 未来45个交易日内，在没有确认的eSLR或中央清算规则的情况下，XLF跑赢SPY 5%
